chapter.verse: Pasian aw, dai dide-in om kei in; lung nuamin, taang loin om kei in, Pasian aw!
Bang hang hiam cih leh na galte in gamlumna piang sak uh a, nang hong mudahte kiphasak uh hi.
Amaute in khem siamna tawh na mite thang siah uh a, amaute in, na itte lang pangin thu kikum uh hi.
Amaute in, “Hong pai un, amaute minam khat hihna panin beisak ni; Israel min kiphawksak nawn kei ni!” ci uh hi.
Hi hi, amaute in siat nading geelin kithukhat uh hi; amaute in nangmah lang pangin thuciam bawl uh hi—
Edom mite leh Ishmael mite, Moab leh Hagri mite,
Gabal, Ammon leh Amalek mite, Filistia leh Tai-ar khua-a teeng mite tawh thuciam bawl uh hi.
Assiria mite in zong amaute pawlpih hi; amaute in Lot suan-le-khakte’ pawl muanhuaite ahi uh hi.
Endor mun-a kizo gawp, lei lakah a luang uh a muatgawp Midian mite’ tunga na bawl bang leh, Kishon gun-a Sisera leh Jabin-te tunga na bawl bangin amaute tungah bawl in.
“Pasian’ gam hoihte eima tan’ dingin la ni,” a ci Oreb leh Zeeb-te bangin amau’ mi liante bawl in la, Zebah leh Zalmunna-te bangin amau a ukte khempeuh bawl in.
Ka Pasian aw, amaute pen, pingpei sunga ninnen, huih mai-a ansi leng bangsak in.
Mei in gamlak a haltum bang, meikuang in mualliante a kuan’sak mah bangin
nangmah in na khuapihuih tawh amaute delh in la, na huihpi tawh amaute lausak in!
Topa aw, amaute in nangma min hong zon’ theih nadingin amaute, maizumna tawh kidimsak in.
Amaute maizumin lungkia densak in la, amaute mindai-in siasak in.
Topa a kici min nei nangmah bek in leitung khempeuhah a Sang Penpa na hihna amaute thei sak in.
